title: Rav Chiyya son of Rav Natan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesachim 41a, teaching Rav Chisda’s statement explicitly, etc., from which Hyman infers that he lived in Rava’s time. In Menachot 39a: “Rav Chiyya son of Rav Natan teaches it thus: Rav Huna said,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Menachot 39a fully writes Rav Chiyya son of Rav Natan and Rav Huna, supporting both abbreviations. The inference that he lived in Rava’s time remains Hyman’s.

The complete Pesachim 41a paragraph has Rav Chiyya son of Rav Natan transmitting Rav Chisda’s statement explicitly. The complete Menachot 39a paragraph fully names Chiyya son of Rav Natan and Rav Huna, followed by the transmission chain. The inference that he lived in Rava’s time remains Hyman’s.
